name: Tobias Zechbauer
headline: Co-Head of Global Credit Research at MEAG - A Munich Re Company
summary:
• Senior manager in the Liquid Markets department of Munich Re’s captive asset manager, with around €300bn assets under management
• Co-heading a global team of around 20 credit analysts in New York and Munich
• More than 15 years of experience in EMEA credit markets with a background as a fundamental fixed-income analyst and credit strategist 
• Established a credit research platform for MEAG in Munich in 2017. Built up a team of 10 credit analysts in a greenfield project
• Developed credit research standards and output formats for regular ad-hoc and monthly publications 
• Integrated ESG analysis and engagement into the team’s processes and the firm’s global credit investment process
• Introduced a global credit research software platform to store and publish credit research information jointly with our colleagues in New York
• Current areas of interest: ESG and carbon (CO2) optimisation of credit portfolios, ESG engagement and impact investing, driving IT efficiencies within the team, operational streamlining of research activities through outsourcing

company.name: MEAG
company.description:
Decades of experience, over 130 investment managers and assets under management of over EUR 300 billion make us one of the most significant institutional players in the world of finance. Headquartered in Munich, and with our global offices in New York and Hong Kong, we offer institutional as well as private investors access to our investment expertise in all major asset classes and solutions geared to growth trends. Our versatile know-how in the field of public markets (including equities, bonds, currencies) and alternative assets (real estate, infrastructure, renewable energies and forestry & agriculture) together with our dedicated ESG focus complement each other in tailor-made solutions for our clients. The transfer of competence and knowledge with Munich Re supports us in seizing opportunities and identify risks prematurely. The incessantly dialogue between the interdisciplinary teams leads to holistic assessments of market movements and trends, which form the basis of our long-term performance success. Our core principle and mission is to focus on our clients' interests and objectives in order to achieve their financial goals together.
